name: Bioma Educacao S.A.
summary: Bahema Educação S.A. is an educational services provider operating across Brazil. The company manages a network of schools and training centers, offering a comprehensive range of programs. These offerings encompass early childhood education, K-12 (elementary and secondary) schooling, basic and continuing education, and specialized entrance exam preparation courses. Originally established in 1953, the company, headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil, changed its name from Bahema S.A. to Bahema Educação S.A. in August 2019.
